text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Shinko Windy breaks away!! A display 
truly worthy of the Dirt King! Right now! 
Dancing across Tokyo Racecourse!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Was she always this strong?! 
Crazy... That final stretch was insane...!

The venue was buzzing with excitement over 
the unexpectedly heated race...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: —Haa, haa, haa!! I won, I won...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
That was spectacular...! The stands are 
buzzing with excitement!! Who on earth 
dared say there was 'no clear favorite'?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehehe... Ihihi...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaa-hah-hah-hah-hah-haaaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
S-Shinko Windy! She is sneering...! She's 
letting out a fierce, roaring laugh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: HELL YEAAAHHHH!!! RAAAAWWWWRRRRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaahhhhh!! Did you see that, 
everyone~~~!!! THIS is Windy-chan~~~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ain't I amazing!?!? Look at me! Look! Look 
at me more!! Wahahaha! Behold the 
1st-place horse girl~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're yelling way too loud. 
Still... that was seriously incredible! 
Congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Everyone kept teasing her as the "biter 
girl," so I kind of saw her that way too, 
but man... she's insanely strong!

text_block_list.name: Windy Fan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... That's right...! She's amazing. 
Windy-chan was so cool...!

The way people viewed her had clearly 
changed...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Hahahaha! What a loud voice you've got!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey you! This spot is only for the 
winner! Shoo! Shoooo!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"What's the big deal?! At least let me say 
'congratulations'!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, that stings. But... it was a great 
race!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Windy-senpai, congrats on 1st place. 
You're really incredible... Really, truly 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu...! Hihihi, hehehehe... Same to 
you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well... they're Windy-chan's rival, after 
all. Only someone strong could fit the 
bill!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...! Y-You're acknowledging me as a rival?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... I changed my mind. I suppose I can 
agree to that.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: U... Uwoooooh!! Windy-senpai...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Did you see that?
choice_data_list: Of course! Great work, you two!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, that was a good race, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was amazed by Windy-senpai. I'm 
sure from here on... it all starts from 
here...!

Shinko Windy nodded as well. She seemed to 
feel good about how it went.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Senpai. Compared to me and the 
others, you've been through a whole lot of 
tough times, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, well, you kinda brought that on 
yourself, though~

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Even if that's the case, you made it this 
far without breaking.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's no small feat. Normally, it 
wouldn't be surprising if someone gave up 
and threw in the towel.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yet, Senpai didn't do that... So watching 
that made me think.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful it is, you can't 
give up on starting over...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not giving up yet either! No matter 
how badly I get beaten down from here on 
out!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I can't let it end with me just losing!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
W-Well... if you don't give up, maybe 
you'll beat Windy-chan someday, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! Not 'someday'! Next time! I'm 
definitely going to win next time!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun! Just what I wanted! Try and beat me 
if you can!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah! Of course!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~, I won-noda♪ I wooon-noda...♪ I 
feel suuuuuper great-noda♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! I'm gonna keep this momentum going 
and win the next one too!"
choice_data_list:
Yeah! Without further ado, let's decide on 
what's next.

Yeah! Without further ado, let's decide 
our next move.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan wants another GⅠ! On a biiiig 
stage, a stage where..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Win again! Show those who still doubt you 
that it's all 'pure skill'!

While she electrified the venue, there are 
likely still people out there who don't 
acknowledge her strength. She seems 
determined to prove every single one of 
them wrong...!

I felt the exact same way. I want to show 
off her true strength even more in a GⅠ 
race!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Teio Sho.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"The Teio Sho, huh...! A splendid choice, 
my evil strategic advisor!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Alright, it's decided! Set up a special 
menu starting tomorrow, right away!

Our next target is the Teio Sho! At this 
rate, we'll spread the word of her 
strength far and wide!
